HONOLULU  — President Nixon, stopping here
yesterday en route to his Vietnam summit conference on
Midway island, believes that the North Vietnamese are
ready for serious peace bargaining.
White House sources, speaking with the President’s
approval, said private talks and indirect contacts with
representatives of Hanoi and the Viet Cong have led to a
conclusion that the stage is set for active negotiations i in
Paris.

The sources, who declined to be named. cautioned
that they expect the enemy to be as tough at the nego-
tiating table as it has been on the battlefield.

NIXON FLIES to Midway today for five hours of con-

ferences with President Nguyen Van Thieu of South |

Vietnam.
Among other matters, they will talk about the even-
tual withdrawal of some U.S.-troops from South Vietnam
as the training of South Vietnamese replacements and
the military Situation permit.
